title: Source
description: A stable source-code identity with optional source-derived publication references.

code.description: The exact, case-preserved source code used as the primary Source identifier.

codeAliases.description: Source-code aliases from the source registry; distinct from publication-title aliases.

publications.description: Optional source-derived publication metadata. Multiple records may share this Source code. Omit for code-only sources.

kind.description: The source metadata collection that supplied this publication reference.

publicationId.description: The source publication ID, included when it differs from the Source code or is needed to distinguish records.

name.description: The supplied publication or adventure name.

revised.description: A supplied revision date, when present in the source metadata.

group.description: The supplied source grouping label. It does not imply edition or rules equivalence.

titleAliases.description: Supplied human-readable aliases for this publication, distinct from Source code aliases.

parentSource.description: The raw parentSource token from metadata. This value is not by itself proof that a canonical parent target has been resolved.
